1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Align within ±35 degrees, with bearing damping 1.2 and settling speed 0.2 rad/s. Less damping retains push momentum and narrows the useful brake/release opportunity.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Align within ±26 degrees, with bearing damping 0.8 and settling speed 0.16 rad/s. Less damping retains push momentum and narrows the useful brake/release opportunity.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Align within ±18 degrees, with bearing damping 0.45 and settling speed 0.12 rad/s. Less damping retains push momentum and narrows the useful brake/release opportunity.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Align within ±12 degrees, with bearing damping 0.25 and settling speed 0.09 rad/s. Less damping retains push momentum and narrows the useful brake/release opportunity.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Align within ±7 degrees, with bearing damping 0.12 and settling speed 0.06 rad/s. Less damping retains push momentum and narrows the useful brake/release opportunity.

simplified.summary: Click signed joint torque buttons to latch each motor independently; click zero to release.

full.summary: Hold A/D and J/L for signed shoulder and elbow torques; releasing keys sets zero.
